statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, r = true if and only if len(s) = len(goal) and there exist indices i and j such that 0 <= i < len(s), 0 <= j < len(s), i != j, and for every k with 0 <= k < len(s), (if k = i then s[j] else if k = j then s[i] else s[k]) = goal[k]. In other words, r = true exactly when some swap of two distinct positions in s produces goal.
preconditions: len(s) >= 1, len(goal) >= 1, len(s) <= 20000, len(goal) <= 20000, and every byte of s and goal is in the inclusive range 97..122 (ASCII lowercase).
